Conclusion:

- Struct name: `DB` (in package `postgres`)
- File path: `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go` (defined at line 16)

This struct implements the `store.Driver` interface for PostgreSQL. Its `NewDB` constructor (line 21) opens a `"postgres"` connection using the `github.com/lib/pq` driver and returns a `store.Driver`, with the assignment `var driver store.Driver = &DB{...}` at line 33 confirming the interface implementation.

Note on naming: the struct is generically named `DB`, but it is disambiguated by its package path `store/db/postgres`. The parallel SQLite and MySQL drivers use the same pattern (each package defines its own `DB` struct implementing `store.Driver`). The full set of PostgreSQL query methods live alongside it in the other files under `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/` (e.g. `user.go`, `memo.go`, `common.go`).
